title: dryopteris nymphalis
intro: Dryopteris nymphalis, commonly known as Spinulose Woodfern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spinulose Woodfern include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
